integrity: The count law derives from the stopped gate resolvent and independently checked strict eigenvalue interlacing; all critical model assumptions and the result's limits are stated in RESULT.md.
scientific_limitations: Only stationary initial binary-gate distribution, strictly positive Brownian diffusion and transition/reset rates, a positive reset position, an absorbing-open/reflecting-closed endpoint, and gate persistence at positional resets are covered.
Global publication priority is limited by the accessible primary-literature and mathematical-record searches; no external independent validation has been performed.
Finite diagnostics do not establish infinite universal statements; the analytic proof is the basis of the theorem.
title: Strict two-geometric reset-count law for a Brownian search with an independently switching gate
